basic_info.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Printronix
basic_info.about:
Accomplished embedded software engineer with demonstrated success in all phases of development from initial design to documentation, coding, verification, and field/factory support. Understands complex systems very quickly, implementing key changes in large code bases without introducing bugs. Often brought in on failing or stalled projects to turn them around, restructuring code as necessary to resolve issues. Highly experienced with both high level software and low level firmware, utilizing schematics, hardware specifications, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers to quickly resolve issues. Combines initiative, innovative techniques, and excellent communication skills to speed development and reduce errors. Key competencies include:

•	Latency Critical SW Development	•	Embedded C / C++ / Assembly Language
•	Leadership / Team Collaboration	•	Software Architectures
•	Design / Application Feasibility  	•	Troubleshooting / Problem Resolution
•	Diagnostic / Test / Measurement	•	Electro-mechanical Control Systems

TECHNICAL

Processors:  ARM iMX6 SoloLite, MSP430, PowerPC 8313, ARM Stellaris LM3S811, Infineon C167
Embedded C, C++, and assembly language development
Real Time and Embedded Operating Systems (RTOS):  ECOS, MTOS, Embedded Linux
Oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, network sniffers, JTAG emulators
Scripting languages/Tools:  Perl, Expect, TCL, Python, UNIX Batch, GNU Make, Source Control Systems
Embedded Network Stack Protocols:  TCP/IP, UDP, ARP, SNMP/MIB, DHCP, Telnet, HTTP, TN/IPDS

experience.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
experience.description:
- Completed C software tasks in design of new ARM iMX6 SoloLite based thermal printer line 1-3 months ahead of schedule, including SD Card driver with FAT32 FFS, NOR flash driver, printer file system, NAND driver, SDMA manager, SPI driver, I2C driver, RGB format TFT LCD driver, embedded scripting application, EIM bus interface, downloading capability, and SDIO-based communications driver to control an external GPIO card
- Reversed decline in cartridge consumable attach rate by developing a relocatable mixed C/assembly proprietary cartridge-based security system with SHA256 Hash Authentication and usage-based expiration; processing distributed between main board processor and MSP430 microcontroller on cartridge. Original deadlines were all met with no significant field complaints despite losing both of the other two software engineers to a company split halfway through the project.
- Developed C++ 1D and 2D barcode verification firmware for an embedded Angstrom Linux-based camera system utilizing freeware libraries Zebra Crossing and OpenCV

experience.title: Staff Software Engineer
experience.description:
- Saved dozens of recurring engineering hours per quarter by restructuring RFID library to add separately downloadable tag and chip info CSV files which could be edited in Excel by technicians
- Project lead on engine for low level hardware control of new P8 Line Matrix PowerPC based Printer Line, including C algorithms for controlling stepper motors, sensors, ADCs, DACs, and electro-mechanical components.  Designed nested state machine based system structure which allowed complex operations to be coordinated among the ten engine tasks precisely, facilitating quick debugging and reducing the number of engine field errors by more than 50% compared to prior projects
-	Quickly resolved numerous key customer issues in the embedded network code, including TCP/IP protocol issues with window size and job sequence numbers, memory corruption induced crashes caused by improper semaphore protection, and RTOS thread management issues

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
experience.description:
- Implemented and extended support for several protocols including DHCP, SNMP Printer MIB, an embedded webpage, and telnet commands
- Was brought in on embedded barcode verification project late in the project to turn it around; restructured code to eliminate numerous structural instabilities, race conditions, and memory corruptions in time for a successful launch of the product

experience.title: Programmer Intern
experience.description:
- Wrote programs to calculate signal path delays and analyze schematic capture data which were used for years afterwards by electrical design engineers in the Storage and Systems Division
- Wrote a manual describing the new tool's features and capabilities

education.activities: Golden Key National Honor Society; Dean's List with Distinction
